tools.description: Stored safety read for one Robinhood Chain token (0x + 40 hex): sellability, launch flags with evidence, where the launch money went, and the move since PumpPill first logged it. tools.name: rh_ticker_resolve
tools.description: The ONE Robinhood Chain contract worth naming for a ticker: alive, $10K+ in its pool, not flagged HIGH or CRITICAL. Other contracts using the name come back as a count, never a list. found=false means nothing clears the gate, which is itself the answer.

tools.name: rh_deployer_record
tools.description: What one Robinhood Chain wallet has launched and how those went: tokens, liveness, liquidity, which crossed $100K. Factory and relayer wallets above the launch ceiling get no record, and so does a wallet with a single launch. No success rate is computed: the rows hold only what crossed.

tools.name: rh_flagged_recent
tools.description: Tokens whose latest scan in the last 30 days found HIGH or CRITICAL structural risk, with the findings named. Each is a finding with evidence, not a verdict on price and not an accusation. Shows what the current wave of bad launches looks like; never a list to trade against.

tools.name: rh_stock_pairs
tools.description: Memecoins quoted in TOKENIZED STOCKS on Robinhood Chain. Pass a stock symbol (NVDA, SPY, TSLA) for the trading, unflagged tokens quoted in it with liquidity and latest scan risk; omit it for every stock with a count. This pairing exists on no other chain.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one result by the id search returned (rh:<address>, sol:<mint> or learn:<slug>). A token id returns the stored read as text with its citation and as-of time; a learn id returns the lesson's full text and, when it has a video, the transcript. Never triggers a scan; a missing read says so.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: room_calls, best_calls, x_chatter, fetch · Private data: rh_token_safety, rh_deployer_record, rh_flagged_recent, rh_stock_pairs, rh_chain_stats, rh_whale_wallets, rh_wallet_record, rh_early_wallets, sol_early_wallets, sol_token_detail, fomo_gathering, fomo_trader, best_calls, agent_buy, agent_sell, rule_matches, agent_status, whats_moving, outcomes_measured, exit_check, premium_calls_recent, my_watched_wallets, x_chatter, search, fetch · Public sink: rh_chain_stats, room_calls, best_calls, outcomes_measured, exit_check · Destructive: sol_token_detail, rh_scan_now.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: room_calls, best_calls, x_chatter, fetch · Private data: rh_token_safety, rh_deployer_record, rh_flagged_recent, rh_stock_pairs, rh_chain_stats, rh_whale_wallets, rh_wallet_record, rh_early_wallets, sol_early_wallets, sol_token_detail, fomo_gathering, fomo_trader, best_calls, agent_buy, agent_sell, rule_matches, agent_status, whats_moving, outcomes_measured, exit_check, premium_calls_recent, my_watched_wallets, x_chatter, search, fetch · Public sink: rh_chain_stats, room_calls, best_calls, outcomes_measured, exit_check · Destructive: sol_token_detail, rh_scan_now

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
